title: Javan
summary: Son of Japheth (Gen 10:2); father of Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim and Dodanim.
description: Son of Japheth (Gen 10:2); father of Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim and Dodanim. Josephus (Antiquities I.6.1, Whiston): "from Javan, Ionia, and all the Grecians, are derived"
